title: TERMAL_CLI has no help: `--help` and `help` fail with "unknown argument"
outcome: An agent that runs the TermAl CLI with --help (or -h, or help) sees its subcommands and their arguments instead of a fatal error.
acceptance: `--help`, `-h` and `help`, alone or after a subcommand, print usage that lists the subcommands and their arguments and exit 0; a test covers each spelling.
Top-level --help, -h and help print useful command usage and exit successfully without starting the host, a runtime, a session or making a backend request.

Usage describes current supported modes and coordination commands, and clearly states that sessions list lists roots while delegation spawn creates children; root creation is directed to the existing UI/API documentation rather than a nonexistent CLI command.
Existing sessions/mailbox help and commands retain their behavior; focused tests cover top-level help dispatch and no-side-effect behavior.
